title: Machine-learning-guided tungsten single atoms promote oxyhydroxides for noble-metal-free water electrolysis.
summary: The model selected tungsten-promoted oxyhydroxide; electrode tests and prolonged electrolyzer operation support the material result. Mechanistic interpretation also uses spectroscopy and DFT.
organization: Seoul National University; Kunsan National University; Pohang University of Science and Technology
